name: Whistle from the Fog
source:
A mysterious plague haunts your town. You discover strange letters accusing an Apothecary of witchcraft. But when you meet her, you can't help but be drawn in.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
一场神秘的瘟疫笼罩着你的小镇。你发现了一些奇怪的信，指控一名药剂师施行巫术。可当你见到她，却情不自禁地被她吸引。

［摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]］
